value.rationale: The model introduces candidate pools and qualitative logarithmic sufficiency for approximate navigation, leaving quantitative constant and exact universal success unresolved. The theorem determines sharp log2 n threshold, two-sided regimes, full Poisson critical window and local-to-global failure equivalence, a natural mathematically motivated navigation invariant.
